invariant: PlantUML's SVG serialization is a backend-wide finalization step: a logical font family equal to Monospaced is emitted as CSS family monospace, and text painted with effective family monospace or Courier has every ASCII space converted to U+00A0 before the DOM serializes it. The conversion depends on the effective emitted font family, whether that family came from the base FontConfiguration or an inline Creole atom.
causal_divergence: The initial change fixed base-family finalization, but the independent review exposed an upstream Creole scope error. Java's CommandCreoleFontFamilyChange changes only the current family and leaves SvgGraphics#text to decide whether that effective family is exactly monospace or Courier. Java's distinct CommandCreoleMonospaced selects the configured Monospaced family for double-quoted Creole. Rust instead sets Style.monospace for every <font:Name> tag, so push_literal converts spaces before final-family classification; proportional names such as Courier New therefore receive NBSP and wider geometry even though Java leaves their spaces literal. The product ratchet then exposed a second distinction: FontStack passes the requested name through java.awt.Font.decode, where the Java logical family is Monospaced while the CSS spelling monospace is unknown and falls back to Dialog/sans metrics. SvgGraphics nevertheless emits CSS monospace and applies NBSP for either effective spelling. Rust's metric_family incorrectly collapsed both spellings to Mono.
planned_change: Keep the shared SVG backend finalization from 336db230. In the Creole family-change branch, store the requested font family without setting the semantic monospace-markup flag; let text_render classify the effective family exactly as Java's SvgGraphics does. Preserve Style.monospace for the dedicated double-quote, backtick, and code markup paths. In the AWT metric-family model, classify Monospaced as the Java logical monospace face but classify the CSS-only name monospace through Java's unknown-family sans fallback; retain SVG canonicalization and NBSP conversion downstream. Update parser/backend tests with Courier New, Courier, Monospaced, and lowercase monospace controls.
